input.query:
Sandbox CRM opportunity OPP-74655. Customer wrote:
"Does Google give us free Directions calls in India, and what happens if we exceed it without a card on file?"
Draft the reply and propose the opportunity field updates. Don't apply anything until I approve.

response_draft.draft_text:
Draft reply:
On the India price list, Directions (and Compute Routes Essentials) include a free usage cap of 70,000 events a month. Pro-tier routing has 35,000 and Enterprise 7,000. Google's FAQ says that if you exceed the free usage cap without a valid payment method on the billing account, 'the API ceases to function until you add a valid payment method.' Tiering aggregates usage across all projects on the billing account.

Proposed sandbox update for OPP-74655 (proposed only, not applied; waiting for human approval): stage=discovery; api=directions; providers=Google Maps Platform; owner=Support L1; next_step=send reviewed answer to customer.

- Google Maps Platform core services pricing list – India (effective Aug 1, 2024; page updated 2026-11-03) (https://developers.google.com/maps/billing-and-pricing/pricing-india): Routes API Legacy pricing: Directions (India) free cap 70,000; $1.50 (cap–5M) / $0.38 (5M+) per 1,000; Directions Advanced (India) 35,000; $3.00 / $0.75
- Google Maps Platform FAQ (https://developers.google.com/maps/faq): if you exceed the free usage cap and you don't have a valid payment method on your billing account ... the API ceases to function until you add a valid payment method.
